answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The quartz holds work receipts rather than names, so the onyx of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jade of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
